segments.name: Connected Fitness Products
segments.description: Sells connected fitness hardware such as bikes, treads and rowers, plus accessories, delivery and installation, warranties and apparel.
segments.evidence: The Connected Fitness Products segment primarily derives revenue from the sale of the Company's portfolio of Connected Fitness Products and related accessories, including Precor-branded fitness products, delivery and installation services

segments.name: Subscription
segments.description: Sells monthly and prepaid subscriptions giving Members access to Instructor-led classes through Peloton equipment and apps.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments: Connected Fitness Products and Subscription.

revenueModel.text: Members pay for connected fitness hardware and for recurring subscriptions to Peloton equipment and app content.
revenueModel.evidence: include all subscriptions to our Peloton Apps for which we currently receive payment
